test_title: PYST 213: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 2nd Nov, 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

Some bolts are pens.

Some stencils are bolts.

All screws are bolts.

Conclusions:

I. No screw is a stencil.

II. Some pens are stencils.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48512a2f8aef1f5fb9444486a282a657a607e22e525d8a7a5b5714c2b72323d0.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. No screw is a stencil. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between screw and stencil. Hence, false)

II. Some pens are stencils. → Do not follow (As, there is no definite relation between pen and stencil. Hence, false) 

Hence, **Neither conclusion I nor II follows**.
